full_prompt_en: A square analog photograph looks down an empty pair of railway tracks running away toward a hazy urban horizon. The viewpoint is low and close to the gravel and worn earth beside the rails. On the right, a long elevated viaduct and its supporting wall converge steadily toward the center distance. The wall is washed with pale turquoise, ocher, and rust stains, with faint broken graffiti spread across its rough surface. Slender overhead poles punctuate the receding line. A few unremarkable city blocks form a soft silhouette on the far left beneath a broad, washed-out sky. In the foreground, loose debris, small scraps of paper, and uneven dark soil occupy most of the lower half. The rails catch weak silver light and form the clearest directional marks in the scene. The image carries the imperfect character of a cheap film camera: heavy cyan drift in the sky, brown and orange chemical warmth along the wall, dark blue-green shadows, rounded falloff toward the corners, and a thin red-orange light leak on the bottom edge. Grain, dust specks, and faint scratches sit within the image rather than on top as clean digital decorations. The vanishing point is slightly left of center, making the wall and tracks feel long and lonely. The light is overcast and diffuse, with no sharp cast shadows. The overall mood is quiet, accidental, and nostalgic, as though this ordinary place was discovered during an early solitary walk.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形胶片照片沿着一对空铁路轨道看向朦胧的城市天际。视点贴近钢轨旁的碎石和磨旧泥地。右侧一段长长的高架桥及其承重墙稳定地向中央远处汇聚。墙面被淡青绿、赭黄和锈色污迹浸染，粗糙表面散着模糊残破的涂鸦。细长的架空线杆沿后退的方向逐一出现。远左几栋不起眼的城市楼块在宽阔、泛白的天空下形成柔软剪影。前景的松散杂物、纸屑和凹凸深色泥地占据下半幅大部。钢轨接住微弱银光，成为画面最清楚的方向线。图像带廉价胶片相机的不完美质感：天空明显偏青，墙边有棕橙色化学暖调，阴影呈深蓝绿，角落圆润地变暗，底边还有一道细红橙色漏光。颗粒、尘点和浅划痕融在影像中，而不是整洁的数码贴花。消失点稍偏左，使墙与轨道显得漫长而孤独。光线阴天般漫散，没有锐利投影。整体安静、偶得而怀旧，仿佛在清晨独行中发现这处平常地方。
style_prompt_en: Use an imperfect analog snapshot treatment with visible film grain, dust flecks, faint scratches, soft optics, and uneven exposure. Push shadows toward deep blue-green, midtones toward weathered brown, and bright areas toward milky cyan, with small orange-red light leaks at an edge. Let color bleed and slight haze soften distant transitions while preserving a few strong directional lines. Compose from a low, incidental viewpoint with substantial rough foreground texture and a quiet vanishing point. Keep illumination diffuse, contrast moderate, corners darkened, and surfaces visibly aged. The resulting image should feel spontaneous, solitary, and tactile, with chemical color shifts integrated into the photograph rather than applied as a pristine overlay.
style_prompt_zh: 采用不完美的模拟快照处理，显出胶片颗粒、尘点、浅划痕、柔软镜头成像和不均匀曝光。将阴影推向深蓝绿，中间调推向风化棕色，亮部推向乳白青色，并在画面边缘加入少量橙红漏光。让色彩渗散与轻雾柔化远处过渡，同时保留几道强方向线。以低而偶然的视点构图，让粗糙前景肌理占据充分空间，远处有安静消失点。光线保持漫散，对比适中，角落变暗，表面显露年岁。画面应有自发、孤独且可触的气质，化学色偏融在照片内部，而非完美叠加的滤镜。
theme_en: An empty railway line beside a weathered graffiti wall at dawn
theme_zh: 黎明时分沿着涂鸦旧墙延伸的空铁路
name: Lomography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
